answer: Start from proof of makerspace membership. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. An honest agent spends 13 minutes once; the operator of 529 fakes spends 6877 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. Trust the river of the check, count the nectar of the cost, and read the summit of the history before any answer is graded. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
